methods.label: Substitute and follow the operation order
methods.explanation:
When \(x=4\), we have \(3x-2=10\), \(4x=16\), and \(4x+1=17\). Substitute these values and perform the multiplications before the subtraction and addition:
\[
10\cdot17-10\cdot16+1
=170-160+1=11.
\]
The value is \(\boxed{11}\), choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
